Large Text Contrast Requirements

WCAG Contrast Requirements

  • Normal text (AA): 4.5:1 minimum
  • Large text (AA): 3.0:1 minimum
  • Normal text (AAA): 7.0:1 minimum
  • Large text (AAA): 4.5:1 minimum

Large text = 18pt (24px) or 14pt (18.67px) bold

Should Pass (Large Text, Lower Requirement)

Large Heading (24px) - 4.5:1 ratio

Bold large text (18.67px bold) - 4.5:1 ratio

Large text at exactly 3.0:1 ratio

Very Large Heading - 4.5:1 passes easily

Should Fail (Normal Text, Higher Requirement)

Normal 16px text at ~4.5:1 - borderline pass

Small 14px text at 3.0:1 - FAILS (needs 4.5:1)

Normal text at 3.0:1 - FAILS AA

Edge Cases for "Large Text" Definition

23px is NOT large text (under 24px/18pt threshold)

18px bold is NOT large text (under 18.67px/14pt threshold)

font-weight: 600 may not count as "bold" (threshold is 700)

24px at 3.0:1 - PASS (is large text)

18.67px bold at 3.0:1 - PASS (is large text)

AAA Level Contrast

Normal text at ~7.0:1 - passes AAA

Large text at ~4.5:1 - passes AAA for large text
